title: Finiteness and duality of groups
summary: Homological finiteness and dimension theory of discrete groups over a commutative ring: the finiteness types FP_n, FP_∞, FP, FL with the Bieri–Eckmann–Brown criterion and stability under finite index, extensions, products and splittings; cohomological and homological dimension; signed tensor induction and Serre's theorem; virtual cohomological dimension, virtual types and finite homological type; geometric dimension and the Eilenberg–Ganea theorem; duality and Poincaré duality groups; Hattori–Stallings ranks over group rings and Swan's theorem; Euler characteristics of groups of finite homological type with multiplicativity, the equivariant formula and denominators for proper cocompact actions; complete resolutions and Farrell cohomology.

targets.name: TauCeti.Huber.isPseudoCoherentOver_iff_ext_colimit
targets.statement: For a ring A, a left A-module M in the universe of A and n : ℕ: M is n-pseudocoherent iff for every directed system (N_i) of A-modules the map colim_i Ext^k(M, N_i) → Ext^k(M, colim_i N_i) is bijective for k < n and injective for k = n, iff colim_i Ext^k(M, N_i) = 0 for k ≤ n whenever colim_i N_i = 0; M is finitely generated (finitely presented) iff the degree-0 map is injective (bijective) for every directed system.
hypotheses: M : Type u, [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
directed systems indexed by a directed preorder in Type u

layers.title: Tensor induction of complexes and Serre's theorem

targets.name: Subgroup.tensorInducedComplex
targets.statement: For H ≤ G of index d with a transversal and a chain complex F of RH-modules indexed by ℕ, the complex F^{⊗_R d} with Koszul-signed differential and the G-action g·(⊗x_i) = ε ⊗_j h_{σ⁻¹ j}(g) x_{σ⁻¹ j}; it is a complex of RG-modules, independent of the transversal up to natural isomorphism, functorial, carries R-linear homotopy equivalences to R-linear homotopy equivalences, sends a resolution of R by R-projective terms to a resolution of R over RG, multiplies length by d, and, for H-free bases, has terms ⊕ Ind_K^G(R_χ) with K finite (K ∩ core H = 1) and χ a sign character.

locator.where: §6, lines 643-651 (Serre's multiplicative induction); Serre1971Prospects n°1.7; BrownGTM87 §VIII.3

layers.title: Duality groups and Poincaré duality groups

targets.name: Group.isDualityGroup_iff

targets.name: Group.IsPoincareDualityGroup
targets.statement: A Poincaré duality group of dimension n over R is a duality group whose dualizing module is free of rank one over R; its orientation character w : G →* Rˣ is the scalar action on D ≅ R; over ℤ, w lands in {±1}, and abstract isomorphisms H^k(G, A) ≅ H_{n−k}(G, ℤ_sgn ⊗ A) for k ≤ n with H^k = 0 for k > n and H_j = 0 for j > n make G a Poincaré duality group with orientation character sgn.
hypotheses: for the abstract-isomorphism theorem: R = ℤ, G : Type, sgn : G →* ℤˣ

locator.where: §3.1, lines 253-257; Theorem 3.4, lines 327-334; BieriEckmann1973 Theorem 4.6, lines 625-643

api.name: orientationCharacter

layers.title: Ranks of projective modules over group rings and Swan's theorem

targets.name: MonoidAlgebra.hattoriStallingsRank
targets.statement: For a finitely generated projective left RG-module P, r_P : ConjClasses G →₀ R from the Hattori–Stallings trace of EtaleCohomologyFoundations §F.10.3 (on (RG)ᵐᵒᵖ) through RG/[RG, RG] ≅ R^(G/conj); additive, iso-invariant, r_{RG} = δ_[1], compatible with base change, induction and (at the identity) restriction to finite-index subgroups; Σ r_P = trace of R ⊗_{RG} P.

api.name: hattoriStallingsRank_add
api.statement: r_{P ⊕ Q} = r_P + r_Q; invariant under isomorphism.

api.name: hattoriStallingsRank_free
api.statement: r_{RGⁿ} = n δ_[1].

api.name: hattoriStallingsRank_baseChange
api.statement: r_{R' ⊗_R P} is the image of r_P.

api.name: hattoriStallingsRank_ind
api.statement: Induction from H ≤ G pushes r_P forward along H-classes to G-classes.

api.name: hattoriStallingsRank_res_one
api.statement: r_{Res P}([1]) = [G : H] r_P([1]) for H of finite index.

tests.name: regular

targets.name: MonoidAlgebra.trace_eq_card_centralizer_mul_rank

tests.name: free_two

tests.name: needs_projective

tests.name: trivial_group

targets.name: MonoidAlgebra.hom_projective_free

targets.name: Group.rationalEulerChar

targets.name: Group.eulerChar
targets.statement: (a) cd_ℤ Γ < ⊤ and Γ' ◁ Γ finite index with f.g. integral homology ⇒ χ_ℚ(Γ') = [Γ:Γ'] χ_ℚ(Γ); (b) for G of finite homological type, χ(G) = χ_ℚ(H)/[G:H] is independent of the torsion-free finite-index H; (c) χ(H) = [G:H] χ(G) at finite index, χ = χ_ℚ ∈ ℤ for torsion-free G, χ = χ̃ for type FL; (d) χ is the unique ℚ-valued function on groups virtually FL multiplicative at finite index and given by ranks for FL (Wall, Serre).

hypotheses: finite homological type of G and of every G_σ

targets.name: Group.CompleteResolution
targets.statement: A complete resolution of R over RG: a ℤ-indexed totally acyclic complex of projectives F with a projective resolution P → R and a chain map F → P that is an isomorphism in degrees ≥ d. If some finite-index H has cd_R H ≤ n, one exists with d = n, and any two are homotopy equivalent compatibly with their maps to P up to homotopy.
